name: Finnmark FD-4 Trinity Infrared and Traditional 2-Person Hybrid Sauna
description: Finnmark FD-4 Trinity Hybrid Sauna Combo, 48"W x 48"D x 78"H Introducing the Finnmark Designs FD-4 Trinity Combination Sauna—an innovation that seamlessly blends Finnmark's UL-listed Spectrum Plus infrared heaters with a traditional 120V sauna heater, enriched by authentic medical-grade Spectrum Red Light™ Therapy. Experience the best of both worlds without compromise. The FD-4 Trinity stands alone as the sole combination sauna featuring genuine UL-listed infrared heaters and a traditional sauna heater. What's more, these cutting-edge elements, including IR panels, red light therapy, and the traditional sauna heater, are all powered by a standard 120V. Revel in the combined benefits of infrared and traditional steam sauna, effortlessly accessible from a common outlet. Feel the heat instantly! Finnmark Designs IR heaters, rigorously tested by Underwriter Laboratories, work harmoniously with a traditional steam sauna stove. The penetrating short-wave far-infrared reaches muscles and joints, inducing a sweat 25 times more than carbon panel heaters. The traditional 1.9kW sauna heater complements the experience—simply sprinkle water on the rocks for a lavish steam sauna encounter, reaping the unmatched benefits and intensity unique to steam saunas. But that's not all—immerse yourself in the rejuvenating embrace of red light therapy, a form of phototherapy that penetrates the skin to stimulate collagen and other proteins, unlocking a myriad of potential health benefits. Elevate your sauna ritual with this perfect enhancement, exclusively from Finnmark Designs. Traditional Sauna Heater Included - Harvia Vega Compact 1900 Features Spectrum Plus™ UL Listed short wave infrared heaters for deep penetrating heat, up to 25x more than standard carbon panel heaters. Spectrum Red Light™ Therapy. 192 Diode medical grade LED panel capable of producing highly beneficial 650nm of red light therapy combined with chromotherapy for those days you need a little love. Antimicrobial Western Canadian cedar interior that protects against mold, bacteria, and fungus. Thermal Plus™ Aspen exterior that will never rot, warp, decay, or chip. Making FinnMark Design's full spectrum infrared saunas one of the healthiest and longest-lasting saunas on the market. 3-IN-ONE Combination. Compromise no more. Introducing the only combination sauna with true UL-listed infrared heaters combined with a traditional heater that produces high-heat steam. Get all the benefits of infrared combined with traditional rocks with steam all while soaking in the benefits of a medical-grade Red light therapy LED panel. Built-in LCD touchscreen controller with Bluetooth audio. Audio with 6" HiFi marine grade speakers, 8mm tempered glass for the ultimate thermal retention. Extra large two-tier bench system Low EMF sauna tested by a NASA award-winning testing facility. High Emissivity infrared heaters Harvia Vega Compact 1900 Wall-mounted design Stainless Steel construction 1.9kW For sauna rooms from 70 to 106 cu. ft. Requires a minimum of 29 lbs of sauna stones (1 Box-AC3000) Please note that each natural stone is unique in shape and size. We recommend purchasing an additional box of sauna stones to allow you to choose the highest quality of stone for fit, form, and function (Additional freight charges will apply). Built-in controls Ergonomic operating switches Switches can be installed on the right or left side of the heater Designed, engineered, and made in Finland Dimensions: 11"W (279mm) x 11"D (279mm) x 21" (533mm) 2-Year Warranty (Consumer use) Manufacturer's Note: Sauna heater stones are significant to the unit's safety. In order for the warranty to remain valid, the user is responsible for proper maintenance. Health Benefits Benefits of Infrared The technology of the Spectrum Plus incoloy heaters warms your core body temperature, producing a cleaner, healthier sweat while lowering blood pressure, and maintaining heart health. The natural heat produced by the Spectrum Plus heaters is designed to achieve a more controlled hot climate much like a traditional sauna without the unbearable heat temperatures. This deeper penetration through sweating goes beyond the muscle and fat rather than a traditional or hot air sauna. As a result, you're able to work up the best possible sweat in the least amount of time. Spectrum Plus heaters remove 17% more toxins such as cholesterol, fat-soluble toxins, toxic heavy metals, sulfuric acid, sodium, ammonia, and uric acid. Full Spectrum Sauna combination of long-wave Spectrum Carbon 360 infrared panels with UL-listed short-wave Spectrum Plus™ infrared panels. This combination provides higher temperatures, full body coverage, deeper penetration, and a better experience than any other sauna. Reap the benefits of a more natural pain relief remedy with every infrared sauna session. Athletes can appreciate a faster muscle recovery with increased blood flow to the muscles, delivering more concentrated oxygen and creating more energy to heal.
